paywall.h.manual: Want a few more bottles tonight?
paywall.s.first: Replies and chats are always free. Membership just gives you more throws and picks each day.
paywall.s.quota: Free users get %1$ld throws and %1$ld picks a day. They reset tomorrow.
paywall.s.manual: Replying, chatting, photos, reporting and blocking are always free.
paywall.consent: If I request a refund, Apple may be sent my usage data
paywall.monthly_note: %ld throws & picks a day · cancel anytime
paywall.legal.renew: %1$@ %2$@, auto-renewing. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically at the same price within 24 hours before the end of each period unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before it ends.
paywall.legal.trial: If you don't cancel before the trial ends, you'll be charged.
paywall.legal.cancel: To cancel: iPhone Settings → your Apple ID → Subscriptions → Drift Bottle → Cancel Subscription, or tap “Manage Subscription” below. Benefits last until the end of the current period. You can switch between monthly and annual at any time.
paywall.legal.refund: Refunds: membership is a digital service that takes effect immediately, and we don't offer refunds. Refund requests are handled by Apple under its policies (reportaproblem.apple.com). If you agree to the option above, we'll share your usage (such as numbers of throws/picks, never chat content) with Apple when it reviews a refund request.
